LESSON: IMITATIVE SPEAKING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.4: Imitative Speaking
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Imitative Speaking, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 5 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can you enhance your imitative speaking skills?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen and repeat saying verbs related to activities carried out at different moments of the day (起 床、睡觉、吃早饭、午饭、晚 饭、做作业),

2. say words related to moments of the day aloud (早上、上午、中 午、下午、晚上),

3. listen and repeat a chant on my day (我的一天)with the correct tones, speed, intonation and rhythm,

4. match various activities to the appropriate moments of the day collaboratively (你什么时候起床 、睡觉、吃早饭、午饭、晚饭 、做作业? ),

5. use pictures/drawings t o describe the daily activities they undertake at different moments in turns,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen and repeat saying verbs related to activities carried out at different moments of the day (起 床、睡觉、吃早饭、午饭、晚 饭、做作业),
2. say words related to moments of the day aloud (早上、上午、中 午、下午、晚上),
3. listen and repeat a chant on my day (我的一天)with the correct tones, speed, intonation and rhythm,
4. match various activities to the appropriate moments of the day collaboratively (你什么时候起床 、睡觉、吃早饭、午饭、晚饭 、做作业? ),
5. use pictures/drawings t o describe the daily activities they undertake at different moments in turns,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Imitative Speaking together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to learn: The learner works collaboratively with their peers to find solutions for the challenges they experience in

pronouncing Chinese words.

• Communication and Collaboration: The learner speaks clearly and effectively using the appropriate speed, intonation and

rhythm as they imitate the chant.

Values:
Unity: The learner displays team spirit as they take turns to make simple descriptions of the activities that they undertake at

different moments of the day.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Peer education and Mentorship: The learner establishes a supportive network among peers when they share constructive

feedback and relatable solutions to the challenges they face when pronouncing Chinese words.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner can relate the skills of turn taking in conversations to their learning in English and Kiswahili.
